svg.text: Regex, gating, rendering and validation are ordinary testable code — only the investigation itself is left to the model, and it is bounded on turns, dollars and tool calls at once.

svg.text: Confidence is checked against the run trace rather than taken on trust: a verdict with no New Relic evidence, or built only on ticket comments, is downgraded and the reason is printed in the comment.
